raw_text: Railway workers union reports that emergency patches are being deployed at major stations following the KAVACH signaling vulnerability disclosure. Maintenance crews working round the clock on Class A routes. Some signaling engineers are concerned that the patches may introduce new issues if rushed. Union has demanded proper testing before deployment.
clean_text: Railway workers union reports emergency patches deploying for KAVACH vulnerability. Maintenance crews working round the clock. Concerns raised about rushed patches introducing new issues.
